title: REQ · Server tests have no execution cases, pass with mocked dependencies and guard against reintroduction
summary: Remaining server tests pass offline and fail if execution or worker code returns
description: Context: server_test.go and removed_code_test.go already cover kept routes and scan for removed imports. Desired behavior: no execution route test remains, tests use temp dirs and a fake git, and the guard tests assert absence of internal/execution and storyforge/worker. Expected result: go test ./internal/server is green. Why: proof the removal is complete.
acceptance_criteria: Given server_test.go, when searched, then no test names or exercises execution, approve or retry routes
Given go test ./internal/server, when run, then all tests pass using only temp dirs and no network
Given a reintroduced execution import, when the guard test runs, then it fails
technical_constraints: Tests mock Git and use t.TempDir
